definitions.explanation: One of the second set of teeth, which replace the baby teeth ({乳歯|にゅうし}) from about the age of six and are meant to last a lifetime. An adult has up to thirty-two, counting wisdom teeth.

examples.japanese: {永久歯|えいきゅうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}えて→生える：02392_haeru⟧きた。
examples.english: A permanent tooth has started coming in.

examples.japanese: {永久歯|えいきゅうし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けたら→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧⟦{二度|にど}と→二度と：06482_nidoto⟧⟦{生|は}えない→生える：02392_haeru⟧。
examples.english: Once a permanent tooth comes out, it never grows back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学生|しょうがくせい}→小学生：03069_shougakusei⟧のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{乳歯|にゅうし}→乳歯：33510_nyuushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧{永久歯|えいきゅうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|は}え{変|か}わる→生え変わる：32223_haekawaru⟧。
examples.english: During elementary school, almost all the baby teeth are replaced by permanent teeth.

notes:
⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧ (permanent) + {歯|し} (tooth). A dentist's and parent's word; in ordinary talk an adult simply says ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {永久歯|えいきゅうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧: a permanent tooth comes in
- {永久歯|えいきゅうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|は}え{変|か}わる→生え変わる：32223_haekawaru⟧: to be replaced by a permanent tooth
- {永久歯|えいきゅうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to look after one's adult teeth
